'''D'nar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], an individual affiliated with the Empire [[Death/Legends|killed]] D'nar while the bounty hunter was in the eastern part of the [[Rust Yards]] outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CharacterModel" /> [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], D'nar lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> D'nar stayed near a stolen [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] located by the coast in the eastern part of the [[Rust Yards]], an industrial area outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While in the Rust Yards, D'nar was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an individual affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
D'nar wore a [[Color/Legends|silver]]-, red-, and tan-colored suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while on Nal Hutta. The armor featured a back-mounted pack connected to the chest plate with a pipe. The armor's left [[Glove/Legends|gauntlet]] contained a small [[Wrist rocket launcher|missile launcher]] and a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]]. D'nar also carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D'nar first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]]. In the game, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter appears as a lower-level boss on Nal Hutta&mdash;known in-game as Hutta&mdash;the starting planet for the bounty hunter and Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]] classes.<ref name="TOR" /> However, any Imperial player class&mdash;[[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], [[Cipher Nine|Imperial agent]], [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]], or [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]&mdash;can kill D'nar, and the bounty hunter's death is one of the required kills for completing the "Hutta's Most Wanted" achievement. While the achievement is not required to continue with any of the main storylines,<ref name="HMW">{{TORcite|Achievement: Hutta's Most Wanted on Hutta}}</ref> this article is written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion. D'nar's [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]] cannot be identified from the game.<ref name="TOR" />

In the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', D'nar is listed among the quest-related non-player characters for the Rust Yards,<ref name="TOREG">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> even though D'nar is neither the starting nor ending character for any quest in the game.<ref name="TOR" /> During the game's recurring Bounty Contract Week event, D'nar does not spawn, as the bounty hunter's location is the area used to fight [[Grov (Evocii)|Grov the Destroyer]], who is the kingpin bounty on the planet Hutta.<ref name="Grov">{{TORcite|[Group] Hutta: Kingpin Bounty}}</ref>
